items.description: Add an F#-implemented, npm-distributed lifecycle CLI (init, status, verify, upgrade, doctor) with a minimal Node bootstrap, installation manifest, file-ownership model, JSON output and stable exit codes, without changing existing library behavior.

items.title: Document the lifecycle conversion: CLI reference, installation and ownership, conversion report
items.description: Write docs/20-lifecycle-cli.md, docs/21-installation-and-upgrade.md and docs/22-lifecycle-conversion-report.md, and correct the .NET availability entry in the documentation audit.

items.title: Make --verbose meaningful on verify, init and upgrade
items.description: The flag was documented on every command but only changed status output. Wire it through verify and the lifecycle commands, and test that it changes what is printed.

items.title: Record cross-platform CI results in the CLI documentation
items.description: The packaged-CLI matrix has run on Linux, Windows and macOS. Replace the 'untested' statements with the measured results, and state precisely which two shipped binaries have never been executed.

items.title: Release 0.5.0: first release carrying the Limen lifecycle CLI
items.description: Bump the package to 0.5.0 (minor: the npm package gains bin entries and five platform binaries; the library surface is unchanged and additive) and tag it so the publish workflow builds, validates and publishes the archive.

items.title: Record the hosted-sandbox git and toolchain limits in CLAUDE.md
items.description: Tag pushes and ref deletions are blocked by the session git proxy while branch pushes succeed; the .NET SDK is available via the Ubuntu archive. Record both, plus the two consequences (releases must be tagged by a human; a scratch branch is permanent and cancels main's CI) so the next agent does not rediscover them.

items.title: Fix the release workflow: npm pack --pack-destination needs the directory to exist
items.description: The v0.5.0 publish failed at the pack step with ENOENT because --pack-destination does not create its target directory. Create it first, and verify the remaining pack/verify/exercise chain locally since those steps had never executed.

items.title: Release 0.5.1: republish after the v0.5.0 pack failure
items.description: v0.5.0 never published because the pack step failed with ENOENT, and its tag cannot be deleted or moved. Bump to 0.5.1 so the fixed publish workflow can release from a fresh tag.

Define and implement federated multi-WASM modules with typed transitions
items.description: Add first-class Limen federation so independently loaded application engines can own bounded state, exchange versioned typed envelopes, request cross-module transitions without shared mutable state, coordinate lifecycle, and be tested deterministically.

items.title: Complete GitHub repository rename from typescript-wasm-kernel to Limen
items.description: Migrate repository identity, GitHub URLs, Pages URL, package repository metadata, documentation, and validation assumptions to kemiller2002/limen while preserving the published npm package name and legacy CLI executable as compatibility surfaces.

items.title: Demonstrate federation with two independent F# WebAssembly modules
items.description: Build a real multi-F#-WASM federation existence proof using two independently published .NET WebAssembly runtimes behind Limen ModuleFederation. Prove versioned cross-module transition request/response, state ownership, typed F# contract decoding, independent runtime identity, snapshots, and real-browser execution without moving domain authority into TypeScript.

items.title: Add federation failure isolation and diagnostics
items.description: Make multi-module Limen federation production-safe when a module transport fails. Add an explicit faulted lifecycle state, semantically blind module diagnostics, and isolated startup that continues independent modules while blocking dependents of failed modules. Preserve existing fail-fast startAll behavior and do not invent domain recovery.

items.description: Write the requirements (LCP-043..LCP-079) for a thin generic IndexedDB capability (the limen.store pack plus a consumable functional F# API) and for the Arca queue-store adapter that replaces Arca's interim localStorage adapter without changing ARCA-OFF-002's port; record DF-LIMEN-2026-0005 (adapter placement, fallback policy, encryption scope); capture the dependency-ordered implementation backlog. Requirements and backlog only, no implementation.

items.title: IndexedDB 1: store pack application namespaces and size policy (LCP-043, LCP-048, LCP-050, LCP-069)
items.description: Order 1 of 10 (docs/requirements/LIMEN-INDEXEDDB-REQUIREMENTS.md, section 17). Depends on WI-0156. Placement: Capability Pack. Additive limen.store contract change: the host registers the pack with an application namespace and every database name is resolved inside it (open, transact, close and deleteDatabase cannot name a database outside it; the database list is limited to it); per-value and per-transaction serialized-size limits answered as InvalidRequest before the database is touched; the browser's quota failure stays Aborted quota. Unit tests plus the Chromium pack smoke. Regenerate F#, C# and Rust bindings; Core untouched.

items.title: IndexedDB 2: store pack compound key paths, count and range delete (LCP-043, LCP-047, LCP-054)
items.description: Order 2 of 10. Depends on WI-0157 (same contract unit; serialized to avoid conflicting contract versions). Placement: Capability Pack. Additive limen.store contract change: a store or index keyPath may be a list of paths (a compound key); count { store, index?, range? } and deleteRange { store, range } operations inside transactions, with the same atomicity and typed results; schema comparison understands compound key paths. Unit tests and Chromium pack smoke.

items.title: IndexedDB 3: store pack durability and availability evidence - persist, estimate, connection loss, creation evidence, availability classification (LCP-061..LCP-064)
items.description: Order 3 of 10. Depends on WI-0158. Placement: Capability Pack. Requests persist, persisted and estimate (navigator.storage), each answering Unsupported where the API is missing; a ConnectionLost fact when the browser closes a connection abnormally (storage cleared or evicted); Opened carries whether the database was created by this open; an availability request that classifies missing, refused (security or private mode) and broken IndexedDB without claiming to detect ephemeral private storage. Unit tests with a scripted IndexedDB and Chromium pack smoke (ConnectionLost through the DevTools protocol's storage clearing).

items.title: IndexedDB 4: language-neutral store conformance vectors; the TypeScript pack passes them, with multi-tab, quota and interruption scenarios in Chromium (LCP-051..LCP-053, LCP-057, LCP-058, LCP-075, LCP-077)
items.description: Order 4 of 10. Depends on WI-0159. Placement: Tooling / Conformance. conformance/store/ with README and store.vectors.json in the style of conformance/outbox: request sequences across one or two connections with expected results, covering every outcome variant, atomic rollback, readonly refusal, putIf conflict, versionchange and blocked, compound keys, count and range delete, size limits and namespaces. The pack runs them under jsdom with a scripted IndexedDB and in real Chromium. Scenario smokes: two tabs writing the same store, a tab closed mid-transaction (all or nothing after reload), quota through the scripted IndexedDB (real-Chromium quota cannot be produced: docs/41 negative knowledge).

items.title: IndexedDB 5: store pack real-browser runs in WebKit as well as Chromium (LCP-076)
items.description: Order 5 of 10. Depends on WI-0160. Guardrail item (CI workflow and smoke runner). Placement: Tooling / Conformance. Run the store pack smoke and the conformance vectors in Playwright WebKit as well as Chromium in CI, under the same strict CSP and Trusted Types policy (WebKit lacks Trusted Types: record what is and is not enforced there). Record WebKit differences found (quota behaviour, persist, private mode) as negative knowledge in docs/41. Indy targets iPad Safari; Playwright WebKit is not a device, so a manual iPad checklist accompanies each release until a device run exists.

items.title: IndexedDB 7: functional F# store API (Limen.Store engine library): schema values, codecs, Result outcomes, migration planner, structured errors and diagnostics (LCP-045, LCP-049, LCP-053, LCP-055..LCP-057, LCP-072, LCP-073)
items.description: Order 7 of 10. Depends on WI-0159 and WI-0162. Placement: Engine Library (libraries/fsharp/Limen.Store, packaged as EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store). Pure F#: immutable schema and request values, a codec pair per stored type (encode to JSON, decode to Result), every pack outcome as a closed union returned in Result, never an exception; the only effect is a StoreExecutor function the host supplies (StoreRequest -> Async<StoreResult>); a pure migration planner for forward-only, idempotent data migrations; typed downgrade and blocked handling; structured StoreError; diagnostics values. No mutable state exposed. Passes limen verify's engine-authority rules.

items.title: IndexedDB 8: F# in-memory store fake with the same contract, and the F# conformance runner over the shared vectors (LCP-074, LCP-075)
items.description: Order 8 of 10. Depends on WI-0160 and WI-0163. Placement: Tooling / Conformance (shipped in EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store as a test support module, or a separate EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store.Testing package). The fake is a pure state machine (state -> request -> state * result) wrapped as a StoreExecutor, modelling several connections (tabs), versionchange, blocked, quota, unavailable and connection loss on demand. It and the real pack pass the same conformance/store vectors; a vector the fake cannot express is reported as unsupported, never as passed.

items.title: IndexedDB 9: store performance baseline and budgets in Chromium and WebKit (LCP-078)
items.description: Order 9 of 10. Depends on WI-0161 and WI-0163. Placement: Tooling / Conformance (bench/). Measure open, single get/put, a 100-record query and a whole-queue snapshot save and load at 64 KB, 256 KB and 1 MB through the F# WASM boundary, in Chromium and WebKit; record the baseline and set budgets in bench/budgets.json with the headroom convention. The LCP-078 numbers are provisional targets until this baseline exists; a miss is recorded as evidence, not hidden.

items.title: IndexedDB 10: release Limen 0.8.0 with the F# store packages, echelon-registry entry and Conditor consumption proof; consumer and privacy guidance in docs/41 (LCP-068, LCP-070, LCP-071, LCP-079, LCP-080)
items.description: Order 10 of 10. Depends on WI-0161, WI-0164 and WI-0165. Placement: release and documentation. Cut the release with npm (provenance) and the attested .nupkg assets; add releases/limen/0.8.0.release.json to echelon-registry with the NuGet artifacts and digests and select it in echelon-current; prove a consumer installs EchelonFoundry.Limen.Contract and EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store through Conditor's NuGet release-asset feed. docs/41 gains the consumer guide: what never to store (tokens), namespaces and the shared-origin caveat, what sign-out clears, and that nothing is encrypted at rest. Unblocks Arca WI-0016. The release tag is pushed by the owner or by dispatching publish.yml on request; never by an agent on its own initiative. docs/41 also explains that the offline-start read cache is Arca's (LCP-082..087, DF-LIMEN-2026-0005 section 4), built on the generic namespaces, compound keys and deleteRange, and that it is cleared at sign-out under both sharedDevicePolicy values.
